description:
Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0

This release prepares the source-first OC Core 1.3 flagship manuscript for public publication through the existing open foundation repository.

The release ships one English master manuscript and two full companion translations in Russian and German. The scientific body stays aligned with the audited Core 1.2 public source corpus and its bounded OC Core 1.3 theorem program.
notes: Prepared from the OC Core 1.3 source-first flagship package. English metadata is primary; Russian and German full translations are shipped as companion artifacts in the same release.
title: Ontology of Continua — Core v1.3.0
